title: THE INSPECTOR WHO FAILED EVERY BRIDGE
deck: A bought inspector has sealed five bridges into a mining district, a maternity clinic has less than twelve hours of oxygen, and an armed ore convoy is coming to erase the evidence. Illuminara must preserve the truth inside Dar Sen's fear without preserving the harm of his lie—and turn one hidden warning into a test no rifle can confiscate.
shape: Five scenes move from a medicine convoy stopped at a red barricade, through Dar's compromised logic and a worker-built acoustic proof, into a confrontation where a wage bond, driver refusal and a costly confession reach Rusk before any steel breaks. Illuminara makes an immediate partial oxygen delivery, while ten line-feed cylinders remain in five paired ground-contact cradles that four carriers can keep level. Rusk suspends the convoy and chooses an unmanned, driver-controlled proof run; Harrow fails under the empty scout without risking a person. Dar enters protected public custody, keeps responsibility, and must transfer the method without owning it.

scenes.title: The Red Barricade
paragraphs: *East Gate Bridge · 06:18, eleven hours and forty-two minutes of oxygen remaining*

The oxygen lorry waited with its engine off beneath a sign that said FAILED in red paint. Frost silvered the five bridges of the Neris Gorge. Beyond them, eighty thousand people woke among the mine chimneys while the maternity clinic's blue warning lamp pulsed above the roofs.

Inspector Dar Sen stood between the lorry and the bridge with a demolition key around his neck. He had put the same red sign on every span into the district. Behind him, residents worked bolt cutters through his barricade.

**Mara Ves**  
The reserve falls below safe pressure at eighteen hundred. There are six newborns on assisted breath and two women in surgery.
Mara, the clinic's senior nurse, held out the pressure log. Dar did not take it.

**Dar**  
No vehicle crosses.

**Mara**  
Then tell me which death your inspection prevents, so I can explain it to the mothers whose children you have chosen instead.
A bolt snapped at the barricade. Dar turned, and twenty district guards raised carbines from the bridgehouse windows. The residents stopped cutting, but they did not step back.

Illuminara landed beside the lorry lightly enough that the frost stayed unbroken. She looked first at the warning lamp, then at Dar's hand. His thumb rubbed a groove in the demolition key as if he had been counting hours with it.

**Illuminara**  
My aim is to get this oxygen to the clinic, stop any crossing that would bring the bridges down, and leave the district with a route it can trust without trusting one frightened man.
Dar flinched at frightened, not at bought.

**Dar**  
You know about the payments.

**Illuminara**  
I know the owners paid you. I do not yet know what they purchased.

A mine siren sounded beyond the gorge. Three short notes meant a convoy had left the northern works. On the ridge, black ore trucks appeared one by one, escorted by armored cars. They were headed not for East Gate but for Harrow Span, the longest and weakest bridge.

**Dar**  
They purchased silence. The failures were mine.

**Mara**  
You closed food, insulin and oxygen for silence?

**Dar**  
I closed heavy roads. Then people began bribing clerks to call their loads light, so I closed all of them. If I publish what I found, the owners send those cars into the district, seize the assay house and call every sample sabotage.
He nodded toward the approaching convoy.

**Dar**  
A true report is paper. Their rifles are steel. My lie is the only thing they have obeyed.
Mara opened the lorry's rear doors. Two travel bottles lay above ten tall line-feed cylinders locked into a shock cradle.

**Mara**  
I can use the two travel bottles for the operating rooms. The ten line-feed cylinders serve the newborn manifold. Tilt a cold regulator more than four degrees and it locks; reset takes eight hours. The sprung cradle keeps them level only while its wheels carry it.

Illuminara took the two travel bottles to the clinic by air and returned six minutes later. The operating rooms gained the night. The blue lamp over the neonatal manifold still counted down to eighteen hundred.

Mara pressed one rear wheel upward by a finger's width. The two-jointed frame twisted; the cradle's pendulum stops released, and the nearest glass bubble ran past its red mark. The ten line-feed regulators were safe only while four ground-contact wheels—or four hands on each paired wheel sling—shared the frame's weight. Lifted from one or two points, the two halves rolled against each other before any carrier could correct them.

Illuminara had strength enough for the lorry and only two hands. A level flight would not undo the twist created at takeoff. The safe cargo needed ten small four-point cradles moving on stone, with a person watching every bubble—not one powerful grip.
She placed one hand on the bridge rail. Deep inside the steel pins, something answered the river's vibration with a scatter of tiny, uneven clicks.
*Not a single crack. A field of them, waiting under clean paint.*

**Illuminara**  
Show us what you found. Mara comes with us, and the demolition key stays where she can see it.

**Dar**  
If the owners arrive before you understand it, they will take the evidence.

**Illuminara**  
Then understanding is the first emergency.
Dar looked at the clinic lamp again. He unclipped the key, put it in Mara's palm, and led them below the bridge.

No barricade opened. The oxygen clock kept running. But the residents lowered their cutters, and the guards lowered their carbines, because for the first time the closure had become a question other people were allowed to inspect.

scenes.title: The Purchased Silence
paragraphs: *East Gate inspection chamber · 08:03, nine hours and fifty-seven minutes remaining*

Dar's hidden laboratory occupied a stone room inside the abutment. Five bridge pins lay on a bench. Four looked new. The fifth had split through its center like dry wood, though its surface still shone.
Bridgewright Lina Or set a spring hammer beside the pins. Her brother had died when a mine gantry failed the previous winter. Dar had signed that gantry safe.

**Lina**  
You knew then.

**Dar**  
I suspected the ore dust. I did not know the water mattered.

He filled two glass dishes from separate bottles. In one lay ordinary bridge dust. In the other, violet-black fines from the new Veyr seam. He added gorge water and lowered identical steel coupons into both. A small current meter trembled over the violet dish.

**Dar**  
The new concentrate carries sulfide glass. Mixed with our alkaline wash water—

**Mara**  
Tell me what it does to the bridge, not what it is called.

**Dar**  
It drives hydrogen into cold-worked steel. The atoms gather around stressed pin holes while the paint stays clean.

He hooked two hair-thin steel wires to the same little weight. One had sat in ordinary bridge dust. The other had sat in Veyr fines and gorge water. The darkened wire parted before the weight cleared the bench; the clean wire held.

**Mara**  
How long does a proper laboratory need to prove that?

**Dar**  
Three weeks. A court needs three months. The owners need twenty minutes to empty this room.

Lina clamped a split pin into a frame, hung a calibrated weight from it, and struck the frame once with the spring hammer. Two ceramic listening tabs, each cheap enough for a school laboratory, sent their traces to a paper recorder. A clean pin made one narrowing wave. The suspect pin answered with a ragged second band below it.

**Lina**  
Acoustic emission. The cracks move under the test load and speak after the strike.

**Dar**  
If you test too hard, you grow them. If you test too softly, a lawyer calls the second band noise.

Illuminara studied the five years of maintenance cards pinned beneath the bench. Dar had circled the same delayed low band at five bridges, two cranes and the failed gantry. He had also signed false invoices, accepted twelve sealed payments and condemned sound masonry approaches so no one could reach the steel spans.

**Illuminara**  
You made yourself the only person who could interpret the warning.

**Dar**  
I made one throat they would have to cut instead of forty.

**Lina**  
You made forty throats dependent on whether you lost your nerve.
Dar did not defend the gantry signature. He laid his bribe ledger on the bench.

**Dar**  
The first payment bought a false assay. I told myself I needed access. The second bought my silence about the first. After that, every bridge failure I issued was true in purpose and false in fact. If I confessed without proof, they would reopen all five and hang the collapse on me. They would not be entirely wrong.
Mara turned the oxygen log face down, not to hide the clock but to keep from using it as a weapon for one minute.

**Mara**  
What would have made you tell us before today?
Dar looked at Lina.

**Dar**  
A warning that did not die when I did. A test the owners could not purchase from one expert. And some chance that stopping the ore would not bring the provincial army to protect the contracts.
Illuminara understood then why arresting him first would repeat the structure of his lie: safety would still depend on whoever held the key and the file.
She set the clean pin, the cracked pin and an unused listening tab in front of Lina.

**Illuminara**  
Can a bridge crew repeat this without believing Dar?

**Lina**  
With a fixed hammer stroke, a fixed hanging weight and two tabs a measured distance apart. Seven minutes per hanger. The result is not a certificate. It is a triage test strong enough to stop a load and demand a proper lab.

**Illuminara**  
Then we do not publish his conclusion. We publish the method, the limits and every raw trace. Miners who lost people run it. Drivers run it. The owners may run it on steel they choose.

**Dar**  
They will jam the recorders and seize the pins.

**Lina**  
Then we use paper drums, tuning reeds and eyes. No network. No single sample.
Mara turned the oxygen log face up again.

**Mara**  
Nine hours and forty-one minutes.
Dar opened a false wall. Behind it were forty listening tabs, six spring hammers, sealed shavings from every span and the original mine wash instructions.

**Dar**  
I was waiting for a day when evidence was stronger than force.

**Illuminara**  
No. You were waiting for evidence to become force by itself. Today people will have to choose what it means.

scenes.title: A Test With Many Hands
paragraphs: *Harrow Span west approach · 11:26, six hours and thirty-four minutes remaining*
Lina painted the test instructions on the tollhouse wall in letters visible across the road: CLAMP. HANG FORTY KILOGRAMS. STRIKE ONCE. READ AFTER TEN SECONDS. DO NOT REPEAT ON A RED RESULT.

Six teams worked on six accessible hangers. Each team included a bridge worker, a miner and someone who did not work for the mine. Mara kept the raw paper traces in clear sleeves. Dar answered technical questions from inside a chalk circle the bereaved families had drawn around him. No one had forgiven him; everyone could see him.

The first clean reference pin drew one sharp curve. The first Harrow hanger produced the low ragged band. So did the second. At the third, Lina handed the hammer to Jori Pell, lead driver of the approaching convoy.
Jori's ore truck waited beyond the armored escort. Her hands were gray with steering dust.

**Jori**  
Captain Rusk says this is theater staged by the inspector who took the bribes.

**Lina**  
That is why you strike it.

**Jori**  
And if I make the line you want, you say I proved it.

Lina rotated the paper drum and covered the earlier traces. She gave Jori three sealed tabs: one for a clean depot pin chosen by the owners, one for a dust-exposed coupon chosen by the miners, and one for the hanger. Jori chose their order and kept the labels in her pocket.

**Lina**  
Blind us, then.
Jori ran all three tests. The clean pin made the narrow wave. The other two made the delayed band. She uncovered the labels herself.
Captain Venn Rusk stepped from the first armored car. His soldiers spread along the road but kept their weapons down. He was broad, tired and wearing a mine rescue badge older than his commission.

**Rusk**  
A low note does not feed eighty thousand people. If this convoy misses the refinery tide, the lenders call the contracts. The province sends receivers with twice my rifles and none of my local drivers.

**Illuminara**  
So your goal is to keep the mine from being taken by people who will care less what breaks.

**Rusk**  
My goal is that workers are paid next week. The inspector had a year to tell us his concern. He sold it instead.

**Dar**  
I told Director Pell. He offered to replace every pin after the winter shipment and paid me to hold the district quiet until then.

**Rusk**  
You accepted.

**Dar**  
Yes.
The plain answer struck harder than an excuse. Rusk's jaw tightened. Jori held up her three traces.

**Jori**  
Let my drivers test the other trucks' route.

**Rusk**  
You are contracted to drive.

**Jori**  
I am licensed to refuse an unsafe span.
Rusk removed a folded order from his coat. Provincial seals covered its edge.

**Rusk**  
Emergency mineral continuity. It suspends local closure powers. At fourteen hundred, one empty scout truck crosses Harrow. If the deck holds, the convoy follows at quarter spacing.

**Lina**  
An empty crossing proves almost nothing. If a hidden pin goes, it may kill the scout and still leave your lawyers calling the death operator error.

**Rusk**  
Then offer something that keeps the contract alive today.
Mara pulled the transport plate from the oxygen cradle and laid it on the bonnet of Rusk's armored car. The red line marked four degrees.

**Mara**  
The travel bottles are already at the clinic. Ten line-feed cylinders still have to cross level. The stone arch is wide enough for their wheel slings by six centimeters, not for this lorry.
Lina drew that six-centimeter clearance on the back of the provincial order. Beside it, Jori spread the convoy manifest.

**Jori**  
The refinery's minimum is four trucks, not forty. The south rail spur can carry four sealed bins if the bins never touch the mine wash.

**Dar**  
There are six clean transfer bins in the old copper shed. I hid them from the inventory when Director Pell ordered everything through the wet crusher.
Jori turned the mine contract to a page Rusk had signed two winters earlier. She put her grease-black thumb beneath one sentence.

**Jori**  
Verified refusal by licensed drivers releases the six-day wage bond. It does not require an owner's permission. My blind trace is one refusal. Forty-six drivers are waiting to repeat it.

**Rusk**  
Verified by whom? The inspector who sold the first assay?

**Jori**  
By me, Lina and whichever engineer you choose. My refusal begins the draw. Your signature can stop the owners delaying it.

The option formed where the objects touched: four trucks on Jori's manifest, six clean bins on Dar's inventory, the bond sentence under Rusk's name and a blue line Lina drew from the rail spur to the refinery. It did not ask the stone arch to carry ore. It left that narrow route for oxygen.

**Illuminara**  
Open the wage bond now. Move the ten cylinders across the arch on level slings. Hold road ore for full testing, then send the refinery minimum by rail in the clean bins. The contract survives today without making a bridge prove itself under forty trucks.
Dar stepped outside the chalk circle before Rusk could answer.

**Dar**  
There is one more thing. The south main pin will fail first. I altered the maintenance map so your crews would reinforce the north and choose another span.

**Lina**  
You weakened the record.

**Dar**  
I thought I could control where the risk went. I cannot ask you to trust the map now. Test the south pin and use this confession against me.

**Rusk**  
Why should a confession from a purchased man change an armed order?

**Dar**  
It should not. The trace changes the order. The confession removes my last way to steer you with a lie.

Rusk's radio spoke in Director Pell's clipped voice: proceed under provincial authority, seize the assay house, deliver Sen to company custody. Rusk listened twice. Then he looked at the bond clause bearing his own signature and at the drivers holding unstruck tabs.

**Rusk**  
If I cross, wages might last one week and the district might lose its roads. If I hold, the bond pays the same week and the rail option keeps the contract alive. That is a choice I can defend.
At 13:49 he wrote a six-hour suspension across the emergency order, activated the wage draw and held the paper where every driver could see it.

**Rusk**  
No loaded vehicle moves. Four sealed bins go to the rail spur only after independent tests. The drivers may refuse without charge.
Engines shut down from the rear of the convoy forward. Rusk had answered the offer before any steel broke.

**Rusk**  
I still need an official strain trace the province cannot dismiss as a bench trick. A real vehicle, a real crossing, every gauge visible.

**Illuminara**  
Does the province require a driver inside it?
Rusk looked at the line he had written across the emergency order.

**Rusk**  
It requires a known empty mass and an unbroken instrument record. Not a person.
Jori pointed to the scout truck's rear recovery eye and the capstan on the west bank.

**Jori**  
Lock the steering, release the engine brake and haul it by rope. My drivers choose the tabs and keep the paper drums. Put a second line on the chassis before it touches the span.

**Lina**  
Anchor that line to the granite pier, not Harrow. If the south pin opens, the truck stops with the proof instead of carrying anyone down.

**Illuminara**  
You asked for evidence the receivers cannot erase. Let the people they would overrule own the instruments, and put no life inside the test.
Rusk crossed out the word DRIVER on his order and wrote REMOTE HAUL—CREW CONTROLLED.

**Rusk**  
Do it. The suspension stands whether the span holds or fails.
At 14:00, the empty scout began to move toward Harrow on Jori's rope. The loaded convoy remained silent behind it.

scenes.title: The Weight of One Crossing
paragraphs: *Harrow Span and the stone service arch · 14:00, four hours remaining*

Jori worked the west-bank capstan with two drivers. Lina had sealed tabs to the south hanger, the truck axles and a clean reference beam; Rusk's chosen engineer watched the labels disappear beneath wax. Illuminara had carried the arrestor cable around the granite pier and stepped away from the truck.
The unmanned scout's front wheels touched Harrow. Its known weight drew a clean axle trace and a ragged second band from the south hanger.

**Rusk**  
Continue at walking speed.

He did not need the crossing to decide whether to stop the convoy; that decision already stood. He needed a record the province could not dismiss, and he had accepted a way to obtain it without spending a driver.

At the midpoint, every listening reed on the south hanger chattered. The main pin split. The deck dropped the width of a hand, and the truck rolled half a wheel before the arrestor cable tightened against granite.

**Lina**  
Hold the capstan. No second strike.

Jori stopped the rope. No person stood on the span. Illuminara braced a loose parapet long enough for the road crew to withdraw its instruments, then let the damaged stone settle where Lina marked it.

The broken pin lay in daylight, its center bright with branching cracks. Jori placed her blind trace beside the continuous load record. Harrow remained standing and unusable; the failure had proved the method without creating the suspension or demanding a rescue.

**Rusk**  
Send the sealed drums with my order. The drivers keep the originals.

**Mara**  
Send them now, before anyone says the bridge had to break for you to listen.
Rusk transmitted the wage draw, raw traces and suspension order to every convoy cab, mine gate and provincial clerk. The paper originals stayed in Jori's hands.
His radio crackled again. Director Pell ordered the armed escort to place Dar in company custody for theft of proprietary samples.
Dar went still. Two owner guards moved toward the chalk circle.
Illuminara stepped between him and the armored cars. She did not hide him behind her.

**Illuminara**  
Public custody, an open evidence chain and a protected escort. He stands trial, and he stays alive to testify. No private car and no sealed room.
Els An brought the magistrate's temporary custody band from the tollhouse. She was the clinic's insulin courier; her sister Hana had gone thirty-one hours without a dose when Dar closed East Gate.

**Els**  
You do not get to disappear into their custody or hide in ours. Take the front handle. You carry what your lie stopped.

Dar accepted the band and the front handle of the first sling. Els took the other end. His knees bent under the weight. She kept the bubble level between its two red marks and did not help him more than the cargo required.

Mara opened the lorry. Two empty travel-bottle slots showed what Illuminara had already delivered. The ten line-feed cylinders waited in five paired wheel slings. Four handles and four ground-contact wheels kept each two-jointed frame from twisting; a glass level made every error visible.
Rusk signed the public-custody refusal and sent it with the evidence packet. The owner guards stepped back, not persuaded, but faced by witnesses whose names were already attached to the record.

**Rusk**  
My command may buy one day before the province replaces me.

**Illuminara**  
Then spend the day making replacement harder.

Illuminara walked beneath the stone arch beside the carriers. She did not touch the cylinders: one powerful grip would twist a paired frame, while four carriers could correct each bubble before it crossed red. When loose blocks threatened the wheels, she held each block only long enough for local masons to wedge it. Mara set the pace. Lina checked every sling. Els and Dar crossed first, breathing the same cold air and choosing, step by step, not to let go.
At 16:47, the clinic manifold accepted the tenth line-feed cylinder. The violet lamp returned to blue with one hour and thirteen minutes left.
Inside the nursery, six small chests kept rising. No speech entered the room. Under Els's eye and a public guard's, Dar repaired a leaking regulator while Mara watched every turn of the wrench.

scenes.title: Three Bridges
paragraphs: *District assay house · 19:14, after the clinic changeover*

The assay house doors had been removed and laid across barrels as worktables. On them rested traces from five bridges, two cranes, three truck axles and steel chosen independently by the owners, bridge crews and miners. The method and its failure limits covered the wall.
Three spans reopened for pedestrians, ambulances and vehicles below a posted mass. Harrow Span and North Chain remained closed for dismantling. No heavy ore moved.
Dar placed twelve payment seals, the altered maintenance map and the original wash instructions before Magistrate Ilen.

**Dar**  
I accepted the first bribe before I knew the mechanism. I accepted the rest after I knew enough to be afraid. I falsified failures, restricted medicine and altered a safety record. The fact that I meant to prevent a larger death does not return anyone the choices I took.
Els stood with her sister Hana, pale but upright. Lina stood with the families of the gantry dead. Harm from the closures and harm from the failed steel had separate faces.

**Els**  
We will testify to what you exposed. We will also testify to what you hid.

**Dar**  
You should.
Rusk laid the wage bond beside the evidence. Its draw would cover six days of wages and begin an independent materials laboratory under Lina, with raw records copied to every road station.

**Rusk**  
I believed uninterrupted work was the only shield against outside control. I nearly destroyed the district to keep command of it.

**Jori**  
Then put the next shipment decision to the crews with the measurements attached.

**Rusk**  
Agreed.

The magistrate ordered Dar to preserve the sample chain, transfer every hidden ledger and teach investigators under Lina's supervision. He would hold no certification vote, touch no sample alone and receive no automatic leniency.

**Els**  
Use what he knows. Do not let him own the test again.

**Dar**  
Agreed.
Mara arrived after the evening rounds and set an empty oxygen-cylinder cap on the table.

**Mara**  
The babies are stable. Tomorrow we need food, insulin and two replacement valves. A victory that blocks tomorrow's lorry is another kind of barricade.
Illuminara found Dar at the open doorway, the custody band bright around his wrists and two public witnesses beside him.

**Dar**  
The rifles were still steel.

**Illuminara**  
Yes.

**Dar**  
You did not defeat them.

**Illuminara**  
No. People who could have driven chose not to. A commander who could have ordered them chose to spend his authority on time. Families who could have abandoned you made you carry with them. The proof gave those choices somewhere to stand.
Dar looked toward the three green bridge lamps and the two dark spans that would never reopen.

**Dar**  
If I had told them a year ago, some might have died in the seizure.

**Illuminara**  
Perhaps. Understanding your fear does not make the harm imaginary. It tells us what the replacement must survive.
The magistrate called him. Dar walked into custody under his own power.
At East Gate, Lina replaced the red FAILED sign with a board showing the tested members, permitted load, next inspection hour and crew on duty. It did not say SAFE.

The first vehicle across was Mara's clinic van carrying empty cylinders back for filling. Jori drove. Els watched the trace drum. On the far side, residents made room without cheering, and the bridge answered the light load with one clean, narrowing note.

critic_line: A bought inspector's fear is answered not by force or rescue but by a proof the crews own: the babies breathe, three bridges reopen, and he stays accountable.

translation_sl.title: INŠPEKTOR, KI JE ZAPRL VSE MOSTOVE
translation_sl.deck: Podkupljeni inšpektor je zaprl pet mostov v rudarsko območje, porodniški kliniki ostaja manj kot dvanajst ur kisika, oboroženi konvoj rude pa prihaja izbrisat dokaze. Illuminara mora ohraniti resnico v strahu Darja Sena, ne da bi ohranila škodo njegove laži — in eno skrito opozorilo spremeniti v preizkus, ki ga ne more zapleniti nobena puška.
translation_sl.shape: Pet prizorov vodi od konvoja z zdravili, ustavljenega pred rdečo zaporo, skozi Darjevo kompromitirano logiko in akustični dokaz, ki so ga zgradili delavci, do soočenja, kjer jamstvo za plače, zavrnitev voznikov in drago priznanje dosežejo Ruska, še preden poči jeklo. Illuminara nemudoma dostavi del kisika, deset jeklenk za dovodni sistem pa ostane v petih parnih nosilih s stikom s tlemi, ki jih lahko štirje nosači ohranjajo vodoravno. Rusk ustavi konvoj in izbere brezposadkovno dokazno vožnjo pod nadzorom voznikov; Harrow popusti pod praznim izvidniškim tovornjakom, ne da bi tvegal človeka. Dar gre v zaščiten javni pripor, ohrani odgovornost in mora metodo predati, ne da bi si jo lastil.

scenes.title: Rdeča zapora
paragraphs: *Most East Gate · 06:18, kisika je še za enajst ur in dvainštirideset minut*

Tovornjak s kisikom je z ugasnjenim motorjem čakal pod napisom ZAPRT, izpisanim z rdečo barvo. Slana je posrebrila pet mostov soteske Neris. Onkraj njih se je med rudniškimi dimniki prebujalo osemdeset tisoč ljudi, nad strehami pa je utripala modra opozorilna luč porodniške klinike.

Inšpektor Dar Sen je stal med tovornjakom in mostom, okoli vratu pa mu je visel ključ za razstrelivo. Enak rdeč napis je postavil na vsak razpon proti območju. Za njim so prebivalci z velikimi kleščami rezali njegovo zaporo.

**Mara Ves**  
Rezerva bo ob osemnajstih padla pod varni tlak. Šest novorojenčkov diha s pomočjo, dve ženski pa sta na operaciji.
Mara, glavna medicinska sestra klinike, mu je ponudila dnevnik tlaka. Dar ga ni vzel.

**Dar**  
Nobeno vozilo ne gre čez.

**Mara**  
Potem mi povejte, katero smrt preprečuje vaš pregled, da bom to lahko razložila materam, katerih otroke ste izbrali namesto nje.
Na zapori je počil vijak. Dar se je obrnil in dvajset okrožnih stražarjev je iz oken mostovne hišice dvignilo karabinke. Prebivalci so nehali rezati, vendar se niso umaknili.

Illuminara je pristala ob tovornjaku tako lahno, da je slana ostala nedotaknjena. Najprej je pogledala opozorilno luč, nato Darjevo roko. S palcem je drgnil zarezo v ključu za razstrelivo, kakor da bi z njim štel ure.

**Illuminara**  
Moj cilj je spraviti ta kisik do klinike, ustaviti vsak prehod, ki bi porušil mostove, in okrožju pustiti pot, ki ji lahko zaupa, ne da bi moralo zaupati enemu prestrašenemu človeku.
Dar je trznil ob besedi prestrašenemu, ne ob podkupljenemu.

**Dar**  
Veste za plačila.

**Illuminara**  
Vem, da so vam lastniki plačali. Ne vem še, kaj so kupili.

Onkraj soteske se je oglasila rudniška sirena. Trije kratki toni so pomenili, da je konvoj zapustil severne obrate. Na grebenu so se drug za drugim pojavili črni tovornjaki rude v spremstvu oklepnih vozil. Niso bili namenjeni proti East Gatu, temveč proti razponu Harrow, najdaljšemu in najšibkejšemu mostu.

**Dar**  
Kupili so molk. Napake so bile moje.

**Mara**  
Zaradi molka ste ustavili hrano, inzulin in kisik?

**Dar**  
Zaprl sem ceste za težka vozila. Potem so ljudje začeli podkupovati uradnike, naj njihove tovore razglasijo za lahke, zato sem zaprl vse. Če objavim, kar sem odkril, lastniki pošljejo tista vozila v okrožje, zavzamejo preskusno hišo in vsak vzorec razglasijo za sabotažo.
Pokimal je proti bližajočemu se konvoju.

**Dar**  
Resnično poročilo je papir. Njihove puške so jeklo. Moja laž je edino, kar so ubogali.
Mara je odprla zadnja vrata tovornjaka. Nad desetimi visokimi jeklenkami za dovodni sistem, pritrjenimi v vzmeteno nosilo, sta ležali dve potovalni jeklenki.

**Mara**  
Potovalni jeklenki lahko uporabim za operacijske dvorane. Deset dovodnih jeklenk oskrbuje razdelilnik za novorojenčke. Če hladen regulator nagnete za več kot štiri stopinje, se zaklene; ponastavitev traja osem ur. Vzmeteno nosilo jih drži vodoravno le, dokler težo nosijo njegova kolesa.

Illuminara je potovalni jeklenki po zraku odnesla do klinike in se vrnila šest minut pozneje. Operacijske dvorane so dobile noč. Modra luč nad razdelilnikom za novorojenčke je še vedno odštevala do osemnajste ure.

Mara je zadnje kolo potisnila navzgor za širino prsta. Dvočlenski okvir se je zvil; omejevala nihala so popustila in najbližji stekleni mehurček je zdrsel čez rdečo oznako. Deset regulatorjev dovodnih jeklenk je bilo varnih le, dokler so težo okvirja delila štiri kolesa v stiku s tlemi — ali štiri roke na vsakem parnem kolesnem pasu. Ko so ga dvignili na eni ali dveh točkah, sta se polovici zavrteli druga proti drugi, še preden bi nosač lahko popravil nagib.

Illuminara je imela dovolj moči za tovornjak, vendar le dve roki. Vodoraven let ne bi odpravil zvijanja, ki bi nastalo pri vzletu. Varen tovor je potreboval deset majhnih štiritočkovnih nosil, ki bi se premikala po kamnu, ob vsakem mehurčku pa človeka — ne enega mogočnega prijema.
Položila je roko na mostno ograjo. Globoko v jeklenih čepih je nekaj odgovorilo na tresljaje reke z razpršenimi drobnimi, neenakomernimi kliki.
*Ne ena sama razpoka. Celo polje razpok, ki čaka pod čisto barvo.*

**Illuminara**  
Pokažite nam, kaj ste odkrili. Mara gre z nama, ključ za razstrelivo pa ostane tam, kjer ga lahko vidi.

**Dar**  
Če lastniki pridejo, preden boste razumeli, bodo odnesli dokaze.

**Illuminara**  
Potem je razumevanje prva nuja.
Dar je še enkrat pogledal luč klinike. Odklopil je ključ, ga položil Mari v dlan in ju odpeljal pod most.

Nobena zapora se ni odprla. Ura s kisikom je tekla naprej. Toda prebivalci so spustili klešče, stražarji pa karabinke, kajti zapora je prvič postala vprašanje, ki so ga smeli preveriti tudi drugi ljudje.

scenes.title: Kupljeni molk
paragraphs: *Pregledna komora East Gata · 08:03, ostaja devet ur in sedeminpetdeset minut*

Darjev skriti laboratorij je zasedal kamnito sobo v oporniku. Na klopi je ležalo pet mostnih čepov. Štirje so bili videti novi. Peti se je po sredini razklal kakor suh les, čeprav se je površina še vedno svetila.
Mostovna mojstrica Lina Or je poleg čepov postavila vzmetno kladivo. Njen brat je prejšnjo zimo umrl ob porušitvi rudniškega žerjava. Dar je tisti žerjav podpisal kot varen.

**Lina**  
Takrat ste vedeli.

**Dar**  
Sumil sem rudniški prah. Nisem vedel, da je pomembna voda.

Iz dveh različnih steklenic je napolnil dve stekleni posodici. V eni je bil navaden mostni prah. V drugi vijoličasto črni drobir iz nove žile Veyr. Dodal je vodo iz soteske in v obe spustil enaka jeklena kupona. Nad vijolično posodico je zatrepetal majhen merilnik toka.

**Dar**  
Novi koncentrat vsebuje sulfidno steklo. Pomešano z našo alkalno odpadno vodo —

**Mara**  
Povejte mi, kaj naredi mostu, ne kako se imenuje.

**Dar**  
V hladno obdelano jeklo potiska vodik. Atomi se zbirajo okoli obremenjenih odprtin za čepe, barva pa ostane čista.

Na isto majhno utež je obesil dve kot las tanki jekleni žici. Ena je ležala v navadnem mostnem prahu. Druga je bila v drobirju Veyr in vodi iz soteske. Potemnela žica se je pretrgala, še preden se je utež dvignila s klopi; čista je zdržala.

**Mara**  
Koliko časa potrebuje pravi laboratorij, da to dokaže?

**Dar**  
Tri tedne. Sodišče potrebuje tri mesece. Lastniki potrebujejo dvajset minut, da izpraznijo to sobo.

Lina je razklani čep vpela v okvir, nanj obesila umerjeno utež in okvir enkrat udarila z vzmetnim kladivom. Dve keramični prisluškovalni ploščici, vsaka dovolj poceni za šolski laboratorij, sta poslali sledi na papirni zapisovalnik. Čist čep je ustvaril en pojemajoč val. Sumljivi čep je pod njim odgovoril z razcefranim drugim pasom.

**Lina**  
Akustična emisija. Razpoke se pod preskusno obremenitvijo premaknejo in po udarcu spregovorijo.

**Dar**  
Če preizkusite premočno, jih povečate. Če preizkusite prešibko, odvetnik drugi pas razglasi za šum.

Illuminara je preučila petletne vzdrževalne kartice, pripete pod klopjo. Dar je enak zakasneli nizki pas obkrožil pri petih mostovih, dveh žerjavih in porušenem žerjavu. Podpisal je tudi lažne račune, sprejel dvanajst zapečatenih plačil in obsodil zdrave zidane dostope, da nihče ne bi mogel priti do jeklenih razponov.

**Illuminara**  
Postavili ste se za edinega človeka, ki lahko razloži opozorilo.

**Dar**  
Ustvaril sem eno grlo, ki bi ga morali prerezati namesto štiridesetih.

**Lina**  
Štirideset grl ste naredili odvisnih od tega, ali boste izgubili pogum.
Dar ni zagovarjal podpisa na žerjavu. Na klop je položil knjigo podkupnin.

**Dar**  
Prvo plačilo je kupilo lažni preskus. Govoril sem si, da potrebujem dostop. Drugo je kupilo moj molk o prvem. Potem je bila vsaka zapora mostu, ki sem jo izdal, resnična po namenu in lažna po dejstvih. Če bi priznal brez dokazov, bi odprli vseh pet in porušitev obesili meni. Ne bi se povsem motili.
Mara je dnevnik kisika obrnila navzdol, ne da bi skrila uro, ampak da ga eno minuto ne bi uporabila kot orožje.

**Mara**  
Kaj bi vas pripravilo, da bi nam povedali že pred danes?
Dar je pogledal Lino.

**Dar**  
Opozorilo, ki ne bi umrlo z menoj. Preizkus, ki ga lastniki ne bi mogli kupiti od enega strokovnjaka. In nekaj možnosti, da ustavitev rude ne bi priklicala deželne vojske, ki varuje pogodbe.
Illuminara je tedaj razumela, zakaj bi njegova takojšnja aretacija ponovila zgradbo njegove laži: varnost bi bila še vedno odvisna od tistega, ki drži ključ in spis.
Pred Lino je položila čisti čep, razpokani čep in neuporabljeno prisluškovalno ploščico.

**Illuminara**  
Lahko mostovna ekipa to ponovi, ne da bi verjela Darju?

**Lina**  
S stalnim udarcem kladiva, stalno visečo utežjo in dvema ploščicama na izmerjeni razdalji. Sedem minut na obešalo. Rezultat ni potrdilo. Je triažni preizkus, dovolj močan, da ustavi tovor in zahteva pravi laboratorij.

**Illuminara**  
Potem ne objavimo njegovega sklepa. Objavimo metodo, meje in vsako surovo sled. Rudarji, ki so izgubili ljudi, naj jo izvedejo. Vozniki naj jo izvedejo. Lastniki jo lahko izvedejo na jeklu, ki ga sami izberejo.

**Dar**  
Motili bodo zapisovalnike in zasegli čepe.

**Lina**  
Potem uporabimo papirne bobne, uglašene jezičke in oči. Brez omrežja. Brez enega samega vzorca.
Mara je dnevnik kisika spet obrnila navzgor.

**Mara**  
Devet ur in enainštirideset minut.
Dar je odprl lažno steno. Za njo je bilo štirideset prisluškovalnih ploščic, šest vzmetnih kladiv, zapečateni ostružki z vsakega razpona in izvirna navodila za pranje rude.

**Dar**  
Čakal sem na dan, ko bodo dokazi močnejši od sile.

**Illuminara**  
Ne. Čakali ste, da bodo dokazi sami postali sila. Danes se bodo morali ljudje odločiti, kaj pomenijo.

scenes.title: Preizkus z mnogimi rokami
paragraphs: *Zahodni dostop do razpona Harrow · 11:26, ostaja šest ur in štiriintrideset minut*

Lina je navodila za preizkus naslikala na steno cestninske hišice s črkami, vidnimi čez cesto: VPETI. OBESITI ŠTIRIDESET KILOGRAMOV. ENKRAT UDARITI. ODČITATI PO DESETIH SEKUNDAH. PRI RDEČEM REZULTATU NE PONOVITI.

Šest ekip je delalo na šestih dostopnih obešalih. Vsako so sestavljali mostovni delavec, rudar in nekdo, ki ni delal za rudnik. Mara je surove papirne sledi hranila v prozornih ovojih. Dar je odgovarjal na tehnična vprašanja iz kroga s kredo, ki so ga okoli njega narisale žalujoče družine. Nihče mu ni odpustil; vsi so ga lahko videli.

Prvi čisti referenčni čep je zarisal eno ostro krivuljo. Prvo obešalo Harrowa je ustvarilo nizki razcefrani pas. Prav tako drugo. Pri tretjem je Lina izročila kladivo Jori Pell, glavni voznici bližajočega se konvoja.
Jorin tovornjak rude je čakal za oklepnim spremstvom. Roke je imela sive od prahu z volana.

**Jori**  
Kapitan Rusk pravi, da je to predstava, ki jo je pripravil inšpektor, prejemnik podkupnin.

**Lina**  
Zato boste udarili vi.

**Jori**  
Če naredim črto, ki jo želite, boste rekli, da sem jo dokazala.

Lina je zavrtela papirni boben in prekrila prejšnje sledi. Jori je izročila tri zapečatene ploščice: eno za čisti skladiščni čep, ki so ga izbrali lastniki, eno za prahu izpostavljeni kupon, ki so ga izbrali rudarji, in eno za obešalo. Jori je izbrala njihov vrstni red in etikete obdržala v žepu.

**Lina**  
Potem nas zaslepite.
Jori je izvedla vse tri preizkuse. Čisti čep je ustvaril ozki val. Druga dva sta ustvarila zakasneli pas. Sama je odkrila etikete.

Kapitan Venn Rusk je stopil iz prvega oklepnega vozila. Njegovi vojaki so se razporedili ob cesti, orožje pa obdržali spuščeno. Bil je širokopleč, utrujen in je nosil značko rudniškega reševalca, starejšo od njegovega čina.

**Rusk**  
Nizek ton ne nahrani osemdeset tisoč ljudi. Če ta konvoj zamudi plimo v rafineriji, posojilodajalci odpovejo pogodbe. Dežela pošlje upravitelje z dvakrat toliko puškami in brez naših krajevnih voznikov.

**Illuminara**  
Vaš cilj je torej preprečiti, da bi rudnik prevzeli ljudje, ki jim bo še manj mar, kaj se zlomi.

**Rusk**  
Moj cilj je, da bodo delavci prihodnji teden plačani. Inšpektor je imel leto dni, da nam pove za svoj pomislek. Namesto tega ga je prodal.

**Dar**  
Povedal sem direktorju Pellu. Ponudil je, da po zimski pošiljki zamenja vsak čep, in mi plačal, da do takrat zadržim okrožje v molku.

**Rusk**  
Sprejeli ste.

**Dar**  
Da.
Preprost odgovor je udaril močneje kot izgovor. Rusk je stisnil čeljust. Jori je dvignila svoje tri sledi.

**Jori**  
Naj moji vozniki preizkusijo pot drugih tovornjakov.

**Rusk**  
Pogodbeno ste zavezani voziti.

**Jori**  
Po dovoljenju smem zavrniti nevaren razpon.
Rusk je iz plašča vzel prepognjen ukaz. Njegov rob so prekrivali deželni pečati.

**Rusk**  
Nujna kontinuiteta dobave mineralov. Razveljavlja krajevna pooblastila za zaporo. Ob štirinajstih bo čez Harrow zapeljal en prazen izvidniški tovornjak. Če bo vozišče zdržalo, bo konvoj sledil v četrtinskih razmikih.

**Lina**  
Prazen prehod ne dokaže skoraj ničesar. Če skriti čep popusti, lahko ubije izvidnika, vaši odvetniki pa bodo njegovo smrt še vedno pripisali napaki upravljavca.

**Rusk**  
Potem ponudite nekaj, kar bo danes ohranilo pogodbo.
Mara je z nosila za kisik vzela transportno ploščico in jo položila na pokrov Ruskovega oklepnega vozila. Rdeča črta je označevala štiri stopinje.

**Mara**  
Potovalni jeklenki sta že na kliniki. Deset jeklenk za dovodni sistem mora še prečkati pot vodoravno. Kamniti lok je za njihove kolesne pasove širši za šest centimetrov, ne pa za ta tovornjak.
Lina je teh šest centimetrov narisala na hrbtno stran deželnega ukaza. Poleg tega je Jori razgrnila tovorni list konvoja.

**Jori**  
Najmanjša količina za rafinerijo so štirje tovornjaki, ne štirideset. Južni železniški odcep lahko pelje štiri zapečatene zabojnike, če se zabojniki nikoli ne dotaknejo rudniške pralne vode.

**Dar**  
V stari bakreni lopi je šest čistih pretovornih zabojnikov. Skril sem jih iz evidence, ko je direktor Pell ukazal, naj gre vse skozi mokri drobilnik.
Jori je rudniško pogodbo odprla na strani, ki jo je Rusk podpisal dve zimi prej. Pod en stavek je položila od masti počrnel palec.

**Jori**  
Potrjena zavrnitev voznikov z dovoljenjem sprosti šestdnevno jamstvo za plače. Dovoljenje lastnika ni potrebno. Moja slepa sled je ena zavrnitev. Šestinštirideset voznikov čaka, da jo ponovi.

**Rusk**  
Kdo jo bo potrdil? Inšpektor, ki je prodal prvi preskus?

**Jori**  
Jaz, Lina in katerikoli inženir, ki ga izberete. Moja zavrnitev začne črpanje. Vaš podpis lahko lastnikom prepreči zavlačevanje.

Možnost je nastala tam, kjer so se predmeti dotaknili: štirje tovornjaki na Jorinem tovornem listu, šest čistih zabojnikov na Darjevem seznamu, določilo o jamstvu pod Ruskovim imenom in modra črta, ki jo je Lina potegnila od železniškega odcepa do rafinerije. Od kamnitega loka ni zahtevala, da nosi rudo. Ozko pot je pustila kisiku.

**Illuminara**  
Takoj sprostite jamstvo za plače. Deset jeklenk prenesite skozi lok na vodoravnih pasovih. Cestno rudo zadržite do popolnega preizkusa, nato pa najmanjšo količino za rafinerijo pošljite po železnici v čistih zabojnikih. Pogodba danes preživi, ne da bi se moral most dokazati pod štiridesetimi tovornjaki.
Dar je stopil iz kroga s kredo, preden je Rusk utegnil odgovoriti.

**Dar**  
Še nekaj je. Južni glavni čep bo popustil prvi. Spremenil sem vzdrževalni zemljevid, da bi vaše ekipe ojačale sever in izbrale drug razpon.

**Lina**  
Oslabili ste zapis.

**Dar**  
Mislil sem, da lahko nadzorujem, kam bo šlo tveganje. Zdaj ne morem zahtevati, da zaupate zemljevidu. Preizkusite južni čep in to priznanje uporabite proti meni.

**Rusk**  
Zakaj bi priznanje podkupljenega človeka spremenilo oboroženi ukaz?

**Dar**  
Ne bi ga smelo. Sled spremeni ukaz. Priznanje mi odvzame zadnji način, da vas usmerjam z lažjo.

Iz Ruskove radijske postaje se je oglasil odrezavi glas direktorja Pella: nadaljujte po deželnem pooblastilu, zasezite preskusno hišo, izročite Sena v pripor družbe. Rusk je sporočilo poslušal dvakrat. Nato je pogledal določilo o jamstvu s svojim podpisom in voznike, ki so držali še neudarjene ploščice.

**Rusk**  
Če prečkam, bodo plače morda trajale en teden, okrožje pa lahko izgubi ceste. Če zadržim, jamstvo plača isti teden, železniška možnost pa ohrani pogodbo. To je odločitev, ki jo lahko zagovarjam.
Ob 13:49 je čez nujni ukaz napisal šesturno ustavitev, sprožil črpanje iz jamstva in papir držal tako, da ga je lahko videl vsak voznik.

**Rusk**  
Nobeno natovorjeno vozilo se ne premakne. Štirje zapečateni zabojniki gredo na železniški odcep šele po neodvisnih preizkusih. Vozniki lahko brez kazni odklonijo vožnjo.
Motorji so ugasnili od zadnjega dela konvoja proti prvemu. Rusk je na ponudbo odgovoril, še preden je počilo jeklo.

**Rusk**  
Še vedno potrebujem uradno sled obremenitve, ki je dežela ne more zavrniti kot trik s klopi. Pravo vozilo, pravi prehod, vsi merilniki vidni.

**Illuminara**  
Ali dežela zahteva, da je voznik v njem?
Rusk je pogledal vrstico, ki jo je napisal čez nujni ukaz.

**Rusk**  
Zahteva znano prazno maso in neprekinjen zapis instrumentov. Ne človeka.
Jori je pokazala na zadnje vlečno uho izvidniškega tovornjaka in vitel na zahodnem bregu.

**Jori**  
Zaklenite krmilo, sprostite motorno zavoro in ga povlecite z vrvjo. Moji vozniki izberejo ploščice in obdržijo papirne bobne. Preden se dotakne razpona, pritrdite še drugo vrv na šasijo.

**Lina**  
To vrv zasidrajte v granitni steber, ne v Harrow. Če se južni čep odpre, se tovornjak ustavi skupaj z dokazom, namesto da bi koga odnesel navzdol.

**Illuminara**  
Zahtevali ste dokaz, ki ga upravitelji ne morejo izbrisati. Naj si instrumente lastijo ljudje, katerih voljo bi preglasili, v preizkus pa ne postavite nobenega življenja.
Rusk je na ukazu prečrtal besedo VOZNIK in napisal DALJINSKI VLEK — NADZOR POSADKE.

**Rusk**  
Storite to. Ustavitev velja, ne glede na to, ali razpon zdrži ali popusti.
Ob 14:00 se je prazen izvidniški tovornjak po Jorini vrvi začel premikati proti Harrowu. Natovorjeni konvoj je za njim ostal tih.

scenes.title: Teža enega prehoda
paragraphs: *Razpon Harrow in kamniti servisni lok · 14:00, ostajajo štiri ure*

Jori je z dvema voznikoma upravljala vitel na zahodnem bregu. Lina je zapečatila ploščice na južno obešalo, osi tovornjaka in čisti referenčni nosilec; inženir, ki ga je izbral Rusk, je gledal, kako etikete izginjajo pod voskom. Illuminara je varovalno vrv ovila okoli granitnega stebra in stopila stran od tovornjaka.
Sprednji kolesi brezposadkovnega izvidniškega tovornjaka sta se dotaknili Harrowa. Njegova znana teža je zarisala čisto sled osi in razcefrani drugi pas z južnega obešala.

**Rusk**  
Nadaljujte s hitrostjo hoje.

Prehoda ni potreboval za odločitev, ali ustaviti konvoj; ta odločitev je že veljala. Potreboval je zapis, ki ga dežela ne bi mogla zavrniti, in sprejel je način, kako ga dobiti, ne da bi žrtvoval voznika.

Na sredini so zašklepetali vsi prisluškovalni jezički na južnem obešalu. Glavni čep se je razklal. Vozišče se je spustilo za širino dlani, tovornjak pa se je premaknil za pol kolesa, preden se je varovalna vrv napela ob granit.

**Lina**  
Zadržite vitel. Brez drugega udarca.

Jori je ustavila vrv. Na razponu ni stal nihče. Illuminara je toliko časa podpirala razrahljano ograjo, da je cestna ekipa umaknila instrumente, nato pa pustila poškodovani kamen sesti tam, kjer ga je označila Lina.

Zlomljeni čep je ležal na dnevni svetlobi, njegova sredica svetla od razvejanih razpok. Jori je svojo slepo sled položila ob neprekinjeni zapis obremenitve. Harrow je ostal stoječ in neuporaben; porušitev je dokazala metodo, ne da bi povzročila ustavitev ali zahtevala reševanje.

**Rusk**  
Zapečatene bobne pošljite z mojim ukazom. Izvirnike obdržijo vozniki.

**Mara**  
Pošljite jih zdaj, preden bo kdo rekel, da se je moral most zlomiti, da bi vi poslušali.
Rusk je nalog za izplačilo jamstva, surove sledi in ukaz o ustavitvi poslal v vsako kabino konvoja, na vsaka rudniška vrata in vsakemu deželnemu uradniku. Papirni izvirniki so ostali v Jorinih rokah.
Njegova radijska postaja je znova zaprasketala. Direktor Pell je oboroženemu spremstvu ukazal, naj Darja zaradi kraje lastniških vzorcev vzame v pripor družbe.
Dar je otrpnil. Dva lastnikova stražarja sta se premaknila proti krogu s kredo.
Illuminara je stopila med njega in oklepna vozila. Ni ga skrila za seboj.

**Illuminara**  
Javni pripor, odprta dokazna veriga in zaščiteno spremstvo. Stopil bo pred sodišče in ostal živ, da priča. Brez zasebnega avtomobila in brez zapečatene sobe.
Els An je iz cestninske hišice prinesla sodnikov začasni priporni trak. Bila je dostavljavka inzulina za kliniko; njena sestra Hana je ostala enaintrideset ur brez odmerka, ko je Dar zaprl East Gate.

**Els**  
Ne boste izginili v njihov pripor niti se skrili v našem. Primite sprednji ročaj. Nosili boste tisto, kar je ustavila vaša laž.

Dar je sprejel trak in sprednji ročaj prvega pasu. Els je prijela drugi konec. Kolena so se mu pod težo upognila. Mehurček je držala med rdečima oznakama in mu ni pomagala bolj, kot je zahteval tovor.

Mara je odprla tovornjak. Dve prazni mesti potovalnih jeklenk sta kazali, kaj je Illuminara že dostavila. Deset jeklenk za dovodni sistem je čakalo v petih parnih kolesnih pasovih. Štirje ročaji in štiri kolesa v stiku s tlemi so preprečevali zvijanje vsakega dvočlenskega okvirja; steklena libela je razkrila vsako napako.

Rusk je podpisal zavrnitev zasebnega pripora in jo poslal z dokaznim svežnjem. Lastnikova stražarja sta se umaknila, ne zato, ker bi bila prepričana, ampak ker so pred njima stali priče, katerih imena so bila že priložena zapisu.

**Rusk**  
Moje povelje nam morda kupi en dan, preden me dežela zamenja.

**Illuminara**  
Potem ta dan porabite tako, da bo zamenjava težja.

Illuminara je hodila pod kamnitim lokom ob nosačih. Jeklenk se ni dotaknila: en močan prijem bi zvil parni okvir, štirje nosači pa so lahko vsak mehurček popravili, preden je prestopil rdečo oznako. Ko so razrahljani bloki ogrozili kolesa, je vsak blok držala le toliko časa, da so ga krajevni zidarji zagozdili. Mara je določala tempo. Lina je preverjala vsak pas. Els in Dar sta šla prva, dihala isti mrzli zrak in se korak za korakom odločala, da ne bosta izpustila.
Ob 16:47 je razdelilnik klinike sprejel deseto dovodno jeklenko. Vijolična luč je spet postala modra, ostala je ena ura in trinajst minut.

V otroški sobi se je še naprej dvigovalo šest drobnih prsnih košev. V sobo ni vstopil noben govor. Pod Elsininim pogledom in ob javnem stražarju je Dar popravil regulator, ki je puščal, Mara pa je spremljala vsak obrat ključa.

scenes.title: Trije mostovi
paragraphs: *Okrožna preskusna hiša · 19:14, po zamenjavi kisika na kliniki*

Vrata preskusne hiše so sneli in jih čez sode položili kot delovne mize. Na njih so ležale sledi s petih mostov, dveh žerjavov, treh osi tovornjakov in jekla, ki so ga neodvisno izbrali lastniki, mostovne ekipe in rudarji. Steno so prekrivale metoda in meje njenih napak.
Trije razponi so se znova odprli za pešce, reševalna vozila in vozila pod objavljeno maso. Harrow in North Chain sta ostala zaprta za razgradnjo. Noben težki tovor rude se ni premaknil.
Dar je pred sodnico Ilen položil dvanajst plačilnih pečatov, spremenjeni vzdrževalni zemljevid in izvirna navodila za pranje.

**Dar**  
Prvo podkupnino sem sprejel, preden sem poznal mehanizem. Druge sem sprejel, ko sem vedel dovolj, da me je bilo strah. Ponarejal sem okvare, omejeval zdravila in spremenil varnostni zapis. Dejstvo, da sem hotel preprečiti večjo smrt, nikomur ne vrne odločitev, ki sem jih odvzel.
Els je stala s svojo sestro Hano, bledo, a pokončno. Lina je stala z družinami umrlih pri žerjavu. Škoda zaradi zapor in škoda zaradi popuščenega jekla sta imeli ločene obraze.

**Els**  
Pričali bomo o tem, kar ste razkrili. Pričali bomo tudi o tem, kar ste skrili.

**Dar**  
Morali bi.

Rusk je ob dokaze položil jamstvo za plače. Izplačilo bo pokrilo šest dni plač in ustanovilo neodvisni laboratorij za materiale pod Lininim vodstvom, surovi zapisi pa bodo kopirani na vsako cestno postajo.

**Rusk**  
Verjel sem, da je neprekinjeno delo edini ščit pred zunanjim nadzorom. Skoraj sem uničil okrožje, da bi ohranil nadzor nad njim.

**Jori**  
Potem dajte odločitev o naslednji pošiljki ekipam, skupaj z meritvami.

**Rusk**  
Strinjam se.

Sodnica je Darju odredila, naj ohrani verigo vzorcev, preda vsako skrito knjigo in pod Lininim nadzorom pouči preiskovalce. Ne bo glasoval o nobenem potrdilu, sam se ne bo dotaknil nobenega vzorca in ne bo prejel samodejne milosti.

**Els**  
Uporabite njegovo znanje. Ne dovolite mu, da bi si znova lastil preizkus.

**Dar**  
Strinjam se.
Mara je prispela po večernem obhodu in na mizo položila prazen pokrovček kisikove jeklenke.

**Mara**  
Dojenčki so stabilni. Jutri potrebujemo hrano, inzulin in dva nadomestna ventila. Zmaga, ki ustavi jutrišnji tovornjak, je druga vrsta zapore.
Illuminara je Darja našla pri odprtih vratih, svetli priporni trak okoli njegovih zapestij, ob njem pa dve javni priči.

**Dar**  
Puške so bile še vedno jeklo.

**Illuminara**  
Da.

**Dar**  
Niste jih premagali.

**Illuminara**  
Ne. Ljudje, ki bi lahko vozili, so izbrali, da ne bodo. Poveljnik, ki bi jim lahko ukazal, je izbral, da svojo oblast porabi za čas. Družine, ki bi vas lahko zapustile, so vas pripravile, da nosite z njimi. Dokaz je tem odločitvam dal prostor, na katerem lahko stojijo.
Dar je pogledal proti trem zelenim lučem mostov in dvema temnima razponoma, ki se ne bosta nikoli več odprla.

**Dar**  
Če bi jim povedal pred letom dni, bi nekateri morda umrli ob zasegu.

**Illuminara**  
Morda. Razumevanje vašega strahu škode ne naredi namišljene. Pove nam, kaj mora prestati nadomestitev.
Sodnica ga je poklicala. Dar je z lastnimi močmi odšel v pripor.
Pri East Gatu je Lina rdeči napis ZAPRT zamenjala s tablo, ki je kazala preizkušene člene, dovoljeno obremenitev, uro naslednjega pregleda in dežurno ekipo. Na njej ni pisalo VARNO.

Prvo vozilo čez most je bil Marin klinični kombi, ki je prazne jeklenke peljal nazaj na polnjenje. Vozila je Jori. Els je opazovala boben s sledjo. Na drugi strani so prebivalci naredili prostor brez vzklikanja, most pa je na lahek tovor odgovoril z enim čistim, pojemajočim tonom.

translation_sl.critic_line: Strah podkupljenega inšpektorja ne dobi odgovora v sili ali reševanju, temveč v dokazu, ki pripada ekipam: dojenčki dihajo, trije mostovi se znova odprejo, on pa ostane odgovoren.
